scenario: A short native text-placement click on a boxplot is buffered into one egui frame

before.result: failed: inline_text was absent after a complete X11 click

input_contract.behavior: PointerState clears press_origin when processing PointerButton release, including when a press and release are buffered in the same frame.

fix: If the held-pointer snapshot has no origin, use the last primary-button press position in the current ordered raw events. Preserve the existing image hit test, drag preview and release commit.
scope: Native wrapper input handling; no renderer, chart SSOT or timing threshold changes.

validation.coverage: Cartesian, logarithmic/inverted, vertical/horizontal boxplot, categorical, radial, radar and polar; each includes native and browser creation, editing, cancellation and export.
